env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# The default budget places the nine JSON keys of the struct in the Sec 7 table.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^1 5 9$'
cd ..

# A seed cap of 1 exhausts the key table search: the build fails at the type
# with the rule ID of Sec 7 and a plain exit, never a compiler crash.
cd m
! logos build -gcflags=all=-d=logosconstmapseeds=1 ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: \[comptime::constmap_seed_not_found\]'
! stderr 'internal compiler error|panic|goroutine'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/jsonseed

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

type Nine struct {
	K1 int `json:"k1"`
	K2 int `json:"k2"`
	K3 int `json:"k3"`
	K4 int `json:"k4"`
	K5 int `json:"k5"`
	K6 int `json:"k6"`
	K7 int `json:"k7"`
	K8 int `json:"k8"`
	K9 int `json:"k9"`
}

func main() {
	var n Nine
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"k1":1,"k5":5,"k9":9}`), &n)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(n.K1, n.K5, n.K9)
}
